debug.extracted_title: Global Software Engineer – Java & Python Solutions

details:
Be part of a leading High Frequency Trading firm with a global footprint, based in Sydney – a high-speed APAC hub for technology-driven trading. Here, mission-critical systems are built, innovation moves fast, and delivery never stops. The impact is tangible, visible, and central to business success.
Design and deliver scalable software solutions in Java and Python, supporting global trading desks with impactful automation and innovative tools.
What You'll Do:
Build scalable, reliable applications for global trading desks.
Create position keeping and reconciliation software.
Develop proprietary tools to automate workflows.
Code, test, deploy, and maintain innovative automation solutions.
Your responsibilities will include:
Collaborating with finance, mid-office, and business planning teams.
Gathering business requirements and stakeholder feedback.
Driving greenfield projects with ownership and accountability.
Solving complex challenges with creativity and proactive problem-solving.
Why Join Us:
Be part of a highly skilled, collaborative tech team.
Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with quick feedback loops.
Gain hands-on exposure to global financial markets.
Enjoy a flat structure that encourages innovation and shared learning.
About You:
Proficient in Java 11+; Python knowledge preferred.
Familiar with Docker, Kubernetes, SQL/NoSQL, and Linux.
Skilled in requirement gathering and stakeholder communication.
Flexible, adaptable, and eager to learn new domains.
This is more than just another engineering role—it’s a chance to shape automation in a global trading environment, own your projects, and thrive in a culture of innovation.
